name: MAG FORGE 130A Airflow
description_1: High-airflow mid-tower case with a mesh front panel for optimal cooling performance. Includes pre-installed Auto-RGB fans for out-of-the-box style.
description_2: Supports up to 240mm radiators and multiple storage drive options. Tempered glass side panel allows for a clear view of your build.

name: MAG FORGE 120A Airflow
description_1: A reliable and stylish chassis designed for builders on a budget. Focused on efficient airflow with a clean aesthetic that fits any workspace.
description_2: Well-organized internal layout for easy cable management. Compatible with standard ATX motherboards and long graphics cards.

name: MAG FORGE 320R Airflow
description_1: The Forge 320R is built for high-end systems needing extensive cooling. Features a larger interior to accommodate 360mm radiators and top-tier GPUs.
description_2: Equipped with an ARGB fan hub for easy lighting control via MSI Center. Premium mesh panels filter dust while allowing maximum air intake.

name: MAG FORGE 320R Airflow white
description_1: A stunning white edition of the performance-focused Forge 320R. Ideal for modern, bright-themed gaming builds with high-end cooling needs.
description_2: Includes matching white ARGB fans and internal cables. Large tempered glass window provides a showcase for your white-themed hardware.

name: MSI Chassis PRO FORGE M050A
description_1: Compact Micro-ATX chassis perfect for home offices and small gaming setups. Offers efficient space usage without sacrificing cooling potential.
description_2: Features a minimalist front design and tool-less assembly options. Includes essential front I/O ports for easy connectivity.

name: MSI Chassis PAG PANO M110A
description_1: The Pano M110A offers a panoramic view of your hardware with its curved tempered glass design. A unique look for any desktop.
description_2: Advanced motherboard support and spacious GPU clearance. Designed to be a centerpiece of your gaming environment.

name: MSI Chassis MAG PANO 110R PZ
description_1: Designed specifically for back-connect motherboards (Project Zero). This case offers the cleanest look with absolute minimal visible cabling.
description_2: Dual-chamber design for better thermal separation. Panoramic glass wrap-around provides a modern and premium architectural feel.

name: MSI Chassis MAG PANO 110R PZ WHITE
description_1: White edition Project Zero case for the ultimate clean aesthetic. No visible wires from the front when used with matching back-connect hardware.
description_2: High-quality materials and a refined finish. Supports top-mounted 360mm radiators for superior CPU cooling performance.

name: MAG PANO M100R PZ
description_1: A premium panoramic Micro-ATX case with high-end features. Includes several ARGB fans and a dedicated cable management zone.
description_2: Support for the latest GPU sizes and advanced cooling solutions. The perfect blend of style and functional performance.

name: MSI Chassis PAG SHIELD M500A
description_1: Rugged and durable mid-tower case designed to protect and showcase your system. Features a unique industrial aesthetic with strong airflow.
description_2: Easy access dust filters and simplified interior for first-time builders. Great value for a high-quality name-brand chassis.

name: MAG PANO 100R PZ
description_1: A large-format panoramic case for ATX systems. Offers a massive interior for showpiece builds with liquid cooling and vertical GPU mounting options.
description_2: Optimized for MSI's Project Zero ecosystem with back-connect support. Features a multi-chamber design for professional-grade thermal management.

name: MAG PANO 100R PZ White
description_1: The ultimate white-themed showcase case. Large glass panels on the front and side provide an unobstructed view of your high-end PC hardware.
description_2: Precision-engineered for cleanliness and performance. Includes a robust I/O panel with USB Gen 2x2 Type-C support.

name: MPG VELOX 100R
description_1: High-performance MPG series chassis with an aggressive design and superior airflow. Includes multiple pre-installed ARGB fans.
description_2: Side-panel airflow options for vertical GPU builds. High-quality tempered glass and solid metal construction for a premium feel.

name: MPG VELOX 100R White
description_1: Clean white gaming case with advanced lighting and cooling features. Designed for high-end systems that need to stay cool and look great.
description_2: Includes a vertical GPU mounting bracket and spacious cable routing options. Sync perfectly with MSI Mystic Light for coordinated RGB.

name: MPG VELOX 300R AIRFLOW PZ
description_1: The Velox 300R AIRFLOW PZ is tuned for the highest thermal performance while supporting the back-connect Project Zero ecosystem.
description_2: Features a large front mesh and pre-installed high-performance fans. Built to handle the hottest next-gen CPUs and GPUs.

name: MPG VELOX 300R AIRFLOW PZ WHITE
description_1: Extreme airflow in a beautiful white finish. Designed for enthusiast builds that prioritize cooling and a clean cable-free look from the front.
description_2: Tool-free access to all panels and high-speed front I/O. Supports massive liquid cooling setups for enthusiasts.
